column2: SW of Hickman to N of Palmyra
column10: Two homes lost large portions of their roofs, and others sustained lesser damage. Trees were downed, and three storage buildings were destroyed. Outbuildings were destroyed and vehicles were moved as well.
Tornado touched down south-southwest of Elmwood and moved mostly over open country before lifting east of town. A few trees were downed.
